item.text:
This pass turned the randomized-loss analysis into a new executed finding and a stronger assurance result.

**F26 — PreAccept broadcasts the wrong sequence number.** `startPhase1` stores the computed `Seq` on the leader’s instance but passes `-1` into `newLeaderBookkeeping`; `bcastPreAccept` reads that bookkeeping, so followers record `seq=-1` while the leader says `seq=0`. The focused test fails on captured code with `PreAccept.Seq=-1, leader instance Seq=0` ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_preaccept_seq_output.txt)); `diagnostic_fix14/` passes the computed sequence and restores consistency ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix14_seq_output.txt)).

**Loss classification.** The new classifier re-runs 1,000 seeds and groups all-NOOP outcomes by pre-recovery holders. Captured: 36 one-holder, 324 two-holder, 222 three-holder losses; the fixed stack has 36 one-holder and 146 two-holder losses. None of the three-holder cases had identical `seq`/`deps` including the leader, so there were **zero fast-path-chosen candidates** among the NOOP losses. The 11 captured mixed divergences remain the safety signal ([captured classification](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_loss_classify_output.txt), [fixed stack](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix13_loss_classify_output.txt)).

The captured suite is now **41 failing finding tests and 5 passing controls**; the report documents **26 findings**. `run_audit.sh` asserts those counts, reruns 100-, 500-, and 1,000-seed campaigns plus the loss classifier, builds, and confirms the captured source is unchanged.
